package_id: WS-NDC-INT-001 / WP-5 NDC v2 conformance package
record_status: workspace documentation and evidence only; implementation states are recorded, not promoted

final_schema_version.manifest_digest_location: detached sidecar only; no self-digest and no property-removal rule in the manifest
final_schema_version.canonicalization: RFC 8785 JCS over the complete manifest object
final_schema_version.signature: Ed25519 over domain bytes concatenated with SHA-256 of the canonical manifest bytes
final_schema_version.signing_domain_note: The trailing \u0000 text denotes exactly one NUL byte appended to the ASCII prefix before the 32-byte digest.

schema_artifact.statement: No standalone published NDC v2 release schema artifact exists at the recorded exact heads. No schema file is invented by this package. The versioned JSON schema files in the Nirnay repository describe research datasets and other subjects; none is an NDC v2 release schema.
schema_artifact.registration_requirement: Profile 1 requires an exact version, a registered digest, strict unknown-field handling and conformance vectors. The version and vector rows are registered here; a standalone published schema artifact remains a separate future work item.

implementation_authorities.authority: typed producer structs ReleaseManifest, SignatureSidecar, ArtifactDescriptor, LineageSupersedes, PublicationReceipt and supporting sections, with private ToJcs conversion
typed consumer structs with deny_unknown_fields on every schema type
typed refusal classes and stable REJECT_* code mapping

normative.label: D1
normative.status: Approved 2026-11-23; bytes and digest preserved; amended by the separately dated D1 amendment

preserved_historical.label: Separate consumer-use proposal
preserved_historical.status: Proposed; no separate approval record; not part of the ratified D0/D1/D2 set

strict_unknown_field_policy.policy: Unknown, duplicate, missing and ambiguous members fail closed. No member is ignored, coerced, defaulted or silently dropped.
strict_unknown_field_policy.producer_mechanism: serde deny_unknown_fields on manifest, section, descriptor, sidecar, receipt and operation types; duplicate property names rejected in JCS parsing; floating-point values refused on the strict manifest and record path
strict_unknown_field_policy.verifier_mechanism: StrictValue duplicate-member rejection, deny_unknown_fields on every schema type, VerifierError::UnknownMember and VerifierError::DuplicateMember mapped to REJECT_SCHEMA_ENVELOPE at stage 1
manifest_forbidden_members: manifest_sha256 as a manifest or digests member
sidecar_forbidden_members: any member outside the five-member sidecar set

capability_states.cross_execution_reason: The two implementations live in separate repositories with no shared invocation boundary and no authorized connector. No producer-generated release was verified by a Nirnay binary in this environment. The typed representations at the recorded heads also differ for several manifest fields, so no wire compatibility is claimed.
capability_states.verification_promotion: none; no IMPLEMENTED state is promoted to VERIFIED or INTEGRATED by this package

non_claims: No release, dataset, admission receipt, signing key, right or market observation is created by this package.
A publisher signature proves publisher-key control over the exact signed bytes only; it proves no source authenticity, coverage, right or dataset entitlement.
No shared validator crate, connector, provider contact, collection, experiment, India implementation or live route is introduced.
No approved D0, D1 or D2 byte or digest is edited. The separate consumer-use proposal remains Proposed.
